settings.lede: Cigala Retail began with one simple mission: to give riders the tools they truly need.

settings.heading: From coaching to Ireland's cycling shop

settings.title: The Beginning
settings.text: In early 2018, Coach Matteo Cigala realised his athletes needed power meters to train smarter and ride faster.

settings.title: Filling the Gap
settings.text: Matteo began sourcing and testing different power meter brands himself, offering them directly to his coaching riders — so they could train with clarity, confidence, and purpose.

settings.title: Growing the Vision
settings.text: Demand grew quickly, and the Cigala Cycling Retail online store was created — offering a wide range of power meters for riders seeking clarity and progress.

settings.title: New Training Tools
settings.text: Soon, more training tools were added: indoor trainers, bike computers, and essential accessories. Nothing random — only what Matteo truly trusted himself.

settings.title: The Expansion
settings.text: Cigala Cycling Retail soon introduced a full range of tools, accessories, bikes, and gear. All premium products — needed not just for cyclists, but for all sports enthusiasts who demand quality.

settings.title: Today
settings.text: Cigala Cycling Retail now offers more than 100 brands and sells across Europe. Trusted by thousands of riders, it’s become a destination for quality, reliability, and performance.

settings.heading: Everything a cyclist needs, in one place
settings.text:
Since day one, Cigala Cycling's mission is to bring all of the cyclist's needs in one location and make them easily available at the consumer's fingertips.

Whether it is to help you improve your cycling & triathlon abilities, to help you shop the right product or to provide you with the most unforgettable cycling tour, Cigala Cycling has you covered.

settings.heading: Your journey deserves the right tools
